name: murmur
description: Murmur rehearses how a community reacts to a pricing or launch change and returns a ranked objection dossier — before you ship.

interface.shortDescription: Rehearse community reaction to pricing/launch changes — ranked objections before you ship
interface.longDescription: Murmur seats a simulated community around your change (pricing page, policy memo, launch brief) and returns a ranked objection dossier: each objection at its strongest, tied to the simulated post behind it, with a counter-case and a test plan for real humans. Deterministic engine runs on your own infrastructure; no third-party API keys.
defaultPrompt: How will developers react to our new pricing? Use Murmur to simulate reactions and rank the objections.
